parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    END AS local_operator_id
  FROM input
), binding AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(b) - 'local_operator_id' AS runtime_binding
  FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
  JOIN normalized AS n
    ON b.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
  WHERE b.node_code = 'FP014-01'
    AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', n.request,
  'runtime_binding', COALESCE((SELECT runtime_binding FROM binding), '{}'::jsonb),
  'config_ready', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM binding),
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM binding) THEN NULL
    ELSE jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED',
      'message', 'An active FP014-01 model and prompt binding is required before sample analysis can start.'
    )
  END
) AS context
FROM normalized AS n;
